title: Coherence and proper support of the tensor square and cube
statement: Let A be a Noetherian commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and f:X to Spec A locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Let G be a coherent O_X-module [pqf-def-coherent] whose support is proper over Spec A [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base]. Then G tensor G and (G tensor G) tensor G [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] are both coherent and both have support proper over Spec A. No separatedness, quasi-compactness or adic-completeness assumption is required.

source.place: Tags 0CYS, 01I8 and 01XZ, as used for the multiplication argument of 09ZT; read the three tag pages on 2026-10-13

proof.text: X is locally Noetherian, so coherent modules are quasi-coherent and finite type. For two coherent modules use the affine tensor-sections comparison and finite affine sections. Their sections tensor product is finite by the Mathlib tensor-finiteness instance, and the tensor-sections map is surjective. The affine-cover criterion makes the tensor sheaf finite type and the coherence criterion makes it coherent. Apply this first to G,G and then to G tensor G,G.

Choose a proper closed subscheme whose ideal annihilates G. To show it annihilates M tensor N if it annihilates M, restrict a section a of the ideal and a section of M tensor N to each contained affine open. Restriction preserves ideal membership by the naturality of the ideal-module inclusion. Use the surjective affine tensor-sections map and tensor induction: a(m tensor n) = (am) tensor n = 0. Linearity treats sums, and the sheaf condition gives the identity on all opens. Apply this twice to the square and cube.

For either coherent tensor power, closed-immersion annihilation gives a quasi-coherent finite-type pullback and an invertible adjunction unit identifying the power with its pushforward from the supporting closed subscheme. This supplies the proper-support criterion witness for each power.

theorem finite_structure_tensor_powers_supported
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of A)) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    (G : X.Modules) (hG : RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace G)
    (hproper : Scheme.Modules.HasSupportProperOver f G) :
    RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace (tensorObj (C := X.Modules) G G) ∧
    Scheme.Modules.HasSupportProperOver f (tensorObj (C := X.Modules) G G) ∧
    RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace
      (tensorObj (C := X.Modules) (tensorObj (C := X.Modules) G G) G) ∧
    Scheme.Modules.HasSupportProperOver f
      (tensorObj (C := X.Modules) (tensorObj (C := X.Modules) G G) G)
